sheets.name: START HERE
rows: Kent LGBTQ+ Homelessness Resource Database — v1.0.1

Purpose: an app-ready first database for LGBTQ+ people in Kent and Medway who are homeless or at risk. It combines statutory routes with specialist, inclusive support and never makes LGBTQ+ identity a condition of help.

First-screen rule: if immediate danger, injury, serious risk of harm, or a child is unsafe, show 999. If someone has no safe place tonight, show their local council emergency route first, then Porchlight / StreetLink and specialist safety support.

Important design safeguards: do not expose identity, abuse, immigration, health or safe-contact fields in notifications. Use consent-led sharing, a quick exit, protected notes, export/delete controls and an audit log. Never promise a bed, eligibility or a legal outcome.

Maintenance: every source has a review interval. Re-check all 'critical' and 'high' services at least monthly, and council emergency contacts / funded schemes immediately when a provider reports change. Do not publish a personal worker directory without provider consent and an owner for updates.

sheets.name: Scripts
rows: Presenting to the council: homeless tonight

I am homeless tonight and I have nowhere safe to stay. I want to make a homelessness application today. My safe contact method is [method]. I am [alone / with children / pregnant / disabled / at risk of violence / other]. Please record that I need an assessment and tell me what temporary accommodation or emergency help is available tonight.
Replace bracketed details only; ask for the officer’s name, reference number and written confirmation.
Presenting to the council: risk within 56 days

I am threatened with homelessness within 56 days because [notice / asked to leave / rent arrears / unsafe home / other]. I want to make a homelessness application and receive a personalised housing plan. I can provide [notice, tenancy, messages, medical evidence]. Please tell me the next appointment and how to send evidence safely.
Do not state that you have left if you have not. Keep copies of notices and messages.

I am LGBTQ+ and I need this information handled confidentially. It may not be safe to contact me by [phone / email / post]. Please use [safe method] and do not contact [name / address] without asking me first. My safety concern is [brief description].
The app should make this an optional protected field, never displayed in notifications.
Prison, hospital, Jobcentre, social worker, probation or clinician

I am homeless or at risk of homelessness within 56 days. I consent to you making a Duty to Refer to [council]. Please give me a copy or reference, record my safe contact method, and tell me what follow-up I need to make myself.
Consent is required. The person should still approach the council directly where possible.
GP registration with no fixed address

I am currently of no fixed abode / staying temporarily locally. I want to register with this GP. I understand I can register without proof of address or ID. If you need a contact address, please use [care-of address / practice address if offered]. I also need an appointment about [health issue] and a letter describing how this affects my housing if clinically appropriate.
If refused, ask for the practice manager and use NHS England guidance in the app.

Because of [disability / health / hearing / communication need], I need these reasonable adjustments: [text/email contact, interpreter, accessible venue, longer appointment, advocate, quiet waiting space]. Please confirm what you can provide and how I should send evidence.
Record the request, date, response and any agreed adjustment.

Please confirm in writing the reason you are asking me to leave and provide all formal notices. I am seeking housing advice. I will keep paying rent where I can and I need communication in writing because [reason]. Please also respond to the repairs / safety issue reported on [date].
Do not advise a person to stop paying rent; refer to Shelter / Citizens Advice for case-specific advice.

I am concerned that the accommodation offered may be unsuitable because [violence risk / disability access / children / medical need / school or care needs / travel safety]. I can provide evidence. Please record this before placement and explain how I can request a review or raise safeguarding concerns.
Accepting accommodation can be complex; get case-specific legal advice before refusing.

I am [age] and live in / am currently in [Kent district]. My current housing is unsafe or unstable because [brief]. I am LGBTQ+ and need confidential, affirming housing advice. I can safely be contacted by [method/times]. My immediate risk tonight is [none / high / emergency].
Never include a person’s identity in a shared device notification.

My release date is [date] and I do not have safe accommodation. Please start or update my resettlement housing plan, make a consented Duty to Refer to [council], and give me copies of my release, risk, benefit and ID documents. I need safe contact by [method].
Start at least 56 days before release when possible.

I am concerned about homelessness / accommodation and need confidential advice about my status. I am LGBTQI+ [optional] and have safety concerns. Please tell me what housing or support route applies, what evidence is needed, and how you will contact me safely.
Do not submit immigration information through an untrusted shared account.
Help request to a trusted person

I’m at risk of having nowhere safe to stay. I don’t need you to solve everything; I need help making a housing call / getting to an appointment / keeping documents / having a safe contact address. Would you be able to help with [one specific thing] today?
Keep the ask small and specific; never pressure someone to disclose identity or abuse details.

rows: Photo ID if available; National Insurance number; safe email/phone; trusted contact
Useful but lack of ID must not block emergency help or GP registration.
Tenancy, licence, rent book, landlord details, council-tax record, messages showing asked to leave
Take screenshots that show dates and sender; store copies safely.
Section 8/21, possession claim, hearing notice, bailiff warrant, lockout evidence
Do not ignore court documents. Route urgently to Shelter / HLPAS / legal advice.
UC journal, payslips, bank statements, rent arrears, utility / council-tax arrears
Redact card numbers before sharing with anyone except verified official services.
Prescription list, discharge papers, clinician letters, accessibility / care needs
Ask clinician to describe functional impact and risk; not to make a legal housing decision.
Child benefit, birth certificates, MATB1, school / care arrangements
Show council promptly; never delay for documents where safety is urgent.
Incident log, photographs, messages, crime reference, risk assessment
Only store if safe. App should have protected storage, quick exit and delete/export controls.
Safe-contact preference, incidents of discrimination, support letters if willingly provided
No one should have to prove LGBTQ+ identity to get homelessness help.
Home Office paperwork, ARC, adviser details, accommodation letters
Store securely; route to regulated advice / Migrant Help.
Release date, probation contact, service record, resettlement plan
Ask for a consented Duty to Refer and retain the reference.
Service number, discharge papers, veteran card if held
Useful for Op FORTITUDE / Veterans Aid; absence should not stop general help.
Date, service, worker, action, deadline, reference, outcome
Create immutable timeline entries; user controls visibility and sharing.

sheets.name: Sources & QA
rows: Official Samaritans source. Free telephone support is available on 116 123, 24 hours a day. The UK email service stopped accepting new users on 27 April 2026 and is scheduled to close completely on 30 September 2026. Do not present jo@samaritans.org as a standard contact route for new users.
